notes:
Passed on the fake backend by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/hybridrobotics__isaac_berkeley_humanoid --backend fake` (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run wD-062 and reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested this package, and no hardware or simulator run was made. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is used. native is the card's first entry symbol, berkeley_humanoid.tasks.locomotion.velocity.config.berkeley_humanoid.rough_env_cfg:BerkeleyHumanoidRoughEnvCfg; the registered environment class is the external omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv (registration file:34-42), so the fake reproduces the external Gymnasium interface and G7 reports the five interface names (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close) as MAYBE_ABSENT. The package serves Velocity-Rough-Berkeley-Humanoid-v0; the Flat and both Play task ids are named in facts.md but are not served. Mock path: the card prefers upstream-sim, but the upstream simulator is Isaac Sim 4.0.0 with Isaac Lab 1.0.0 (README.md:25-27), which is not installed, and the training script launches Isaac Sim and passes cfg=env_cfg to gym.make (scripts/rsl_rl/train.py:39-40 and :88-89); the fake is the package's own pure-Python interface stand-in, and the sim path was not run. NOT COVERED: the full policy observation group. The configured policy group concatenates ten terms (velocity_env_cfg.py:126-143); the fake returns a smaller 15-value observation: 3 fixed placeholder base values and the 12-value last-action term, with every other term omitted, and the real flattened width is built by Isaac Lab outside the clone and was not observed. Also not covered: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain, noise, reward (fixed 0.0), the 4096-environment default (velocity_env_cfg.py:347), the reset randomizations (velocity_env_cfg.py:223-246), the configured time-out and torso-contact termination (velocity_env_cfg.py:315-318), rendering and wall-clock pacing. The action space is published as an unbounded 12-value Box because the clone states the joint-position action and its 0.5 scale (velocity_env_cfg.py:115) but no numeric action bound; no bound was invented, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe and G8 awards CL2. driver.lock.json backends is the class's fake entry .fake:FakeBerkeleyHumanoidEnv. Expected warnings, none a failure: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for the Gymnasium interface supplied by the external Isaac Lab base; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs, which the bridge derives without units. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings; all 26 Facts cite text lines of the clone, checked by printing every cited range. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the last gate run printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The upstream clone was not modified (git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no is empty).
